explanation.headline: Eribulin mesylate is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21

sentences.text: FDA's records show eribulin mesylate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 84 vials of the 0.5 mg/mL, 2 mL presentation with a daily use of 4.8 vials, providing 17.6 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is to buy from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today.
Hikma's supply is traced to Kindos Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., whose last inspection was classified VAI on 2024-07-19.
Additional alternate manufacturers include Apotex Corp. and BSP Pharmaceuticals SpA, neither of which is on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
